Subject: [UAI] Postdoc Opening at RPI


A post doctorate associate/visiting scholar is sought in decision 
making/information fusion using Bayesian Networks.  We are interested in 
candidates with significant experience in theoretical developments of 
Bayesian Networks (BN) and Influence Diagrams (ID), and in the application 
of BN and ID for computer vision, information fusion, and decision making. 
Strong solid mathematical and statistical background and excellent programming
skills are also essential.

Interested parties, please contact Dr. Qiang Ji at gfp@rpi.edu for 
details. For current research and active projects in our lab., please 
visit  http://www.ecse.rpi.edu/~qji
